analysis.reasonEn: Holding for the 15th session since the last buy signal. RSI rose from 55.9 to 61.3, confirming an exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram is worsening, but the Higher Low pattern remains intact, suggesting potential for continued uptrend. Volume ratio at 0.82 (vs 5-day average) indicates no lack of conviction in the movement.
analysis.narrative:
[추세 위치]
· 현재가($328.00) vs SMA5/20/50($322.46/$325.19/$287.15): 단기·중기 추세 상회 진단
· SMA100/200($232.66/$217.23) 대비 높은 위치: 중장기 추세 강도 유지
· 52주 위치(93.8%) + 현 가격대 역사적 고점 근접 구간
[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (55.9→61.3) + 과매도 탈출 중 진단 + 상승 방향성 확인
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-1.8562→-2.9476) + 악화 유지 진단 + 추세 전환 신호 미확인
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 $325.19) + 밴드폭 9.55%로 정상 수준
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($253.59) + 근거 (피벗 S2 기반)
· 스윙 저항선 ($341.95) + 돌파 시 신고가 경신 가능성
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Higher Low) + 상승 추세 지속 진단
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.82배) + 움직임의 신뢰도 정상 수준
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 보유 관점 유지 및 추가 상승 기대
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($328.00) vs SMA5/20/50 ($322.46/$325.19/$287.15): Short/mid-term trend above moving averages confirmed.
· High position relative to SMA100/200 ($232.66/$217.23): Mid-to-long-term trend strength maintained.
· 52-week position (93.8%) + Current price level near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (55.9→61.3) + Diagnosed as exiting oversold + Upward momentum confirmed.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.8562→-2.9476) + Diagnosed as worsening, holding steady + No trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $325.19) + Bandwidth at 9.55%, indicating normal levels.
[Support & Resistance]
· Swing Support ($253.59) + Based on Pivot S2.
· Swing Resistance ($341.95) + Potential for new highs if breached.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (Higher Low) + Uptrend continuation diagnosed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.82x) + Normal conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + Holding position, expecting further upside.
